readout_other: novel object recognition; in vivo LTP and depotentiation fEPSP in dentate gyrus; Abeta, Iba1, CD11C, CD68 immunostaining; Western blot; BV2 CCK-8, transwell and phagocytosis assays
direction_notes: TMAS and, less strongly, TUS reduced amyloid plaque burden, improved memory and LTP, and increased microglial activation, proliferation and phagocytosis; effects were largest with TMAS.

exposures.label: TUS and TMAS (with static magnet), bilateral hippocampus of 5xFAD mice

timing.protocol_description: 0.6 ms tone bursts at 1 kHz PRF for a 400 ms sonication duration (TUS parameters); Results describe a 300 ms ultrasonic pulse excitation signal followed by a 4000 ms ultrasound interval. 5 min daily treatment for 2 weeks. TMAS adds a 0.15 T static magnet.
